chunks.title: LEQ — Long Essay Question (6 points) — Q2 Set 2: Impact of the Columbian Exchange in the Atlantic
chunks.content: AP World History LEQ, 6 points, standardized rubric. A Thesis/Claim [1]. B Contextualization [1]. C Evidence [0–2]: two specific pieces (1), used to support the argument (1). D Analysis and Reasoning [0–2]: reasoning process (causation/CCOT) (1), complex understanding (1). Q2 Set 2 prompt: the impact of the Columbian Exchange in the Atlantic world. Common failure: no defensible thesis; evidence not tied to the argument; reasoning without complexity.
